summary: Overworks and Sega's sky-pirate JRPG, originally a Dreamcast classic and later expanded as the GameCube director's-cut-style Legends version.

entries.title: Skies of Arcadia
entries.definitive_edition: Skies of Arcadia Legends on GameCube

emulation.emulator: Dolphin for GameCube; Flycast/Redream for Dreamcast secondary content
emulation.notes: Use Dolphin-upscaled Legends for the main run and Dreamcast emulation/hardware only for Pinta Quest archival coverage.

primary.why: Skies of Arcadia Legends is a director's cut and adds more detailed character models, a more stable frame rate, reduced loading, new side quests/subplots, hidden discoveries, a Wanted List, fewer random encounters, and integrated Dreamcast downloadable content.
primary.how_to_play: Play Skies of Arcadia Legends on GameCube hardware, Wii backward compatibility, or Dolphin for upscaled capture. Use the Dreamcast original only for VMU/Pinta Quest and original-release comparison.

secondary.exclusive_content: The Dreamcast original has the VMU-dependent Pinta Quest minigame and original VMU notification behavior that the GameCube version removed or moved to the TV.
secondary.what_to_play: Sample Pinta Quest and VMU behavior on Dreamcast hardware or compatible Dreamcast emulation.
secondary.why: The GameCube version removed Pinta Quest and moved VMU-style effects to the television.

all_releases.reason: secondary: original route with VMU/Pinta Quest content, but Legends is the expanded main version.

all_releases.fidelity: Skies of Arcadia Legends director's-cut-style port with extra content, more stable frame rate, reduced loading, and slightly more detailed character models.
all_releases.reason: primary: most complete main-play version; Dolphin can upscale it for capture.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: GameCube Legends is the complete main route, while Dreamcast retains VMU/Pinta Quest behavior absent from Legends.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official modern remaster is documented. Legends adds substantial content but removes the VMU Pinta Quest minigame from the Dreamcast original.
